answer_verbatim:
If you want **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **Awake Academy’s *Embracing the Shadow***, and **Sacred Humans’ *Inner Healing Shadow Work Course***, because they explicitly frame shadow work as part of broader inner healing or spiritual development.[8][20][18]

A practical shortlist, organized by best fit:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | A more psychologically grounded introduction | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a Jungian psychology series.[8][16] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** (Awake Academy) | A spiritually oriented, transformative approach | The course page emphasizes transformation in relationships and personal growth, which suggests a broader spiritual/self-development framing.[20] |
| **Inner Healing Shadow Work Course** (Sacred Humans) | A comprehensive, all-in-one course | It explicitly includes shadow work, emotion regulation, spiritual awakening, relationships, and mindful living.[18] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | Guided practice with meditations and prayers | The description mentions lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[17] |
| **Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing** (Insight Timer) | Meditation-centered learning | It presents shadow work as integration of self across mind, body, heart, and spirit.[19] |

If you want a more traditional **Jungian psychology** route, start with **Jung Platform**.[8][16] If your priority is **spiritual transformation and practice**, **Sacred Humans** and **Udemy’s Shadow Work Course and Workbook** are the clearest matches from the results.[18][17]

A few lower-cost or more beginner-friendly options also appear in the results, including **Udemy’s Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self**, **Shadow Work Essentials**, and **Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices**.[3][10][6] These are useful if you want a flexible self-paced format, but the available descriptions in the results are less specific about spiritual practice than the courses above.[3][10][6]

If you want, I can also rank these by **best for beginners**, **best for spirituality**, or **best value**.
